text: A factory/hook raised outcome shall fail its node without installing its object/registering its callback, retrying, continuing dependents, or entering the application. Its explicit exceptional CFG shall clean up its own partial resources; earlier committed callbacks shall drain in reverse registration order, then terminal `initialization_failed` shall be reported.
